scripts.build: tsc -p packages/kernel && tsc -p packages/cli && chmod +x packages/cli/dist/cli.js
scripts.typecheck: bun run build && tsc -p packages/kernel/tsconfig.test.json && tsc -p packages/cli/tsconfig.test.json && tsc -p prototype && tsc -p e2e && tsc -p factory
scripts.test: bun run build && bun run test:python && bun test packages prototype
scripts.e2e: bun e2e/empty-folder.ts bun && bun e2e/empty-folder.ts npm && bun e2e/empty-folder.ts bun hono && bun e2e/empty-folder.ts npm hono && bun e2e/empty-folder.ts bun express && bun e2e/empty-folder.ts npm express && bun e2e/empty-folder-python.ts
scripts.test:python: cd python && uv sync --quiet && uv run pytest -q
scripts.conformance:write: BLOK_CONFORMANCE_WRITE=1 bun test packages/kernel/test/conformance.test.ts && cd ../.. && bunx biome format --write specs/blok-pattern/conformance
